name: pi-permission-system
notes: Forked from gotgenes/pi-packages; local wrapper-floor rework (fallback mode) intentionally diverges from upstream. v32.0.5 sync adopted upstream's parent-session prompting for UI children (#907/#909), deny-preempts-ask (#899), transient filesystem retry for forwarded writes (#914), command-string secret redaction (#920), bash partial-parse salvage (#875), and unregistered chain-link warning (#861), while preserving the fork's named permission profiles, session role layer, wrapper floors, and forwarded-decision broadcast. The bash salvage merge keeps fork's parseProgram recursion (wrapperFloors) alongside upstream's withSalvagedRoots via a module-level activeParseProgram.
